Welcome! If you've ever been part of an ambitious organization, you know the feeling—standing at that crossroads where growth brings both excitement and a whole new set of challenges. Maybe you’ve felt that initial spark… and then wondered how to keep it burning as things get bigger and a bit more complicated.
Together, we're about to explore the journey from scrappy startup to thriving, scalable company. And it takes more than just big dreams and hard work, doesn’t it? What really makes the difference is having the right habits, clear systems, and a disciplined approach to leadership and strategy. When teams are empowered, priorities line up, and progress feels steady, that’s when real growth happens.
In Verne Harnish’s book, Scaling Up: How a Few Companies Make It...and Why the Rest Don't, he shares the practical habits and frameworks that help high-growth organizations stand apart from the rest. Instead of relying on the founder’s energy alone, Harnish shows us how the right rhythms and routines can transform teams, align goals, and sustain momentum.
So, what does it take to break through those tough growth barriers? We’ll dive into the Rockefeller Habits 2.0 framework—a toolkit designed to help leaders master the four game-changing decisions: People, Strategy, Execution, and Cash. With real-world examples and hands-on advice, you’ll see how organizations can turn complexity into opportunity and chaos into clarity.
This isn’t just about getting bigger. It’s about getting better—building a culture where improvement never stops and lasting success is within reach. Ready to discover how companies make the leap? Let’s set out on this journey together.
